Are you tired of the Slime Hutch's size not fitting seamlessly into your farm's layout? "Slime Hutch Resize" is the mod tailored just for you!


Not only does this modification change the original 11x6 size of the Slime Hutch to a more compact and aesthetic 7x3 size, but we've also meticulously retextured the Slime Hutch. It transitions from its former proportions of 11x9 tiles to the revamped 7x6 format. This ensures the Slime Hutch now fits like a glove in your diverse farm layouts.

However, a crucial note for players: If you have existing Slime Hutch structures on your farm, you might face issues with the building's exit. It's essential to move the structure with Robin's help to update to the new entrance correctly.

We've always felt that the original size of the Slime Hutch felt somewhat out of place. With "Slime Hutch Resize", you’re set to enjoy a farm that’s both functional and visually harmonious.

Note: This mod is not compatible with any mods that change the Slime Hutch textures. Since its size has been altered, it incorporates its own unique retexture. At the moment, no other retextures are compatible. However, our team is actively working on introducing new retextures for a smoother and enhanced Stardew Valley experience. Stay tuned for updates and enjoy the harmony it brings to your farm layout!
